data.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Says It's 'Illogical' to Think AI Will Replace Software Tools
data.summary: Worries about artificial intelligence disrupting the software business are overblown, Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang said.  "There's this notion that the software industry is in decline and will be replaced by AI," Huang said late Tuesday at an event hosted by Cisco, hours after a selloff in U.S. software stocks.  "There's a whole bunch of software companies whose stock prices are under a lot of pressure because somehow AI is going to replace them," Huang said.
